spans.s:
√ghṛṣ 'rub'
present: [1.] gharṣati etc. E.+ gharṣate etc. 
perfect: jagharṣa 
[aorist: agharṣīt gharṣiṣyati gharṣitā ]
verbal: ghṛṣṭa E.+ ghṛṣṭvā -ghṛṣya S.+ 
secondary: passive: ghṛṣyate etc. ghṛṣyati etc. E.+ -- causative: gharṣita 
derivatives: gharṣa E.+ -gharṣin C. gharṣaṇa E.+ -ghṛṣṭi E. ghṛ́ṣu RV. -ghṛ́ṣva TA. ghṛ́ṣvi RV. 
The relation to this root of the last three derivatives is doubtful.
